set -ex

apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl jq build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev

# --default-toolchain none, deliberately: NEEDLE's rust-toolchain.toml
# is the single source of truth and pins an exact version. Installing
# `stable` here too makes rustup download TWO toolchains per run, and
# re-resolving the `stable` channel is what broke rust-verify for every
# repo on 2026-08-05 — a mid-job auto-update to 1.97.1 died with
# "Invalid cross-device link (os error 18)" because rustup's temp dir
# and toolchain dir are on different mounts in this image, and
# `cargo check` never ran at all.
#
# With `none`, rustup materialises the pinned toolchain (plus the
# rustfmt/clippy components the file declares) on first cargo use
# inside /workspace. Version is echoed there, once it exists.
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none --profile minimal
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"

curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
  | dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
  | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null
apt-get update && apt-get install -y gh

git clone --depth 1 --branch main \
  "https://github.com/jedarden/NEEDLE.git" \
  /workspace
cd /workspace

# First cargo/rustc call in the repo — rustup installs the toolchain
# pinned by rust-toolchain.toml here, exactly once.
rustc --version

VERSION=$(grep -m1 '^version' Cargo.toml | sed 's/.*= *"\(.*\)".*/\1/')
echo "Building NEEDLE v${VERSION}"
COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

# Run all unit tests and the sanitization latency assertion test.
# Neither `cargo test` invocation below passes --release, so both
# compile and run unoptimized (debug) binaries. Do NOT export
# SANITIZE_THRESHOLD_MS=10 here — 10ms is the test's documented
# *release-build* target and is unreachable for this CPU-bound
# workload in an unoptimized build (observed CI median: ~170-580ms
# depending on node), so setting it unconditionally fails every
# run regardless of code health. Leave it unset so the test uses
# its own build-mode-aware default (1500ms in debug builds, with
# real headroom over observed CI latency; 10ms in release builds).
# See tests/sanitize_latency_assertion.rs for details.
cargo test --lib
cargo test --test sanitize_latency_assertion

cargo build --release

PLATFORM_SUFFIX="$(uname -m)-unknown-linux-gnu"
cp ./target/release/needle "./target/release/needle-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}"
cp ./target/release/needle-transform-claude "./target/release/needle-transform-claude-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}" 2>/dev/null || true
cp ./target/release/needle-transform-codex "./target/release/needle-transform-codex-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}" 2>/dev/null || true

# Package claude-interactive plugin
cp ./plugins/claude-interactive/claude-interactive "./target/release/claude-interactive"
cp ./plugins/claude-interactive/claude-interactive.yaml "./target/release/claude-interactive.yaml"
cp ./plugins/claude-interactive/install.sh "./target/release/claude-interactive-install.sh"

if gh release view "v${VERSION}" --repo jedarden/NEEDLE > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release v${VERSION} already exists — skipping"
  exit 0
fi

gh release create "v${VERSION}" \
  --repo jedarden/NEEDLE \
  --title "NEEDLE v${VERSION}" \
  --notes "Release v${VERSION}

Built from commit: ${COMMIT}" \
  --target main \
  "./target/release/needle-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}" \
  "./target/release/needle-transform-claude-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}" \
  "./target/release/needle-transform-codex-${PLATFORM_SUFFIX}" \
  "./target/release/claude-interactive" \
  "./target/release/claude-interactive.yaml" \
  "./target/release/claude-interactive-install.sh"

echo "Release v${VERSION} created successfully"

script.source:
set -e
apk add --no-cache jq >/dev/null 2>&1

git clone --branch {{workflow.parameters.branch}} \
  "https://github.com/{{workflow.parameters.git-repo}}.git" \
  /tmp/repo
cd /tmp/repo

if [ -f VERSION ]; then
  VERSION_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- VERSION | grep -c '^VERSION$' || true)
  if [ "$VERSION_CHANGED" -gt 0 ]; then
    VERSION=$(cat VERSION | tr -d '[:space:]')
    echo "VERSION file changed — using ${VERSION}"
  else
    CURRENT=$(cat VERSION | tr -d '[:space:]')
    MAJOR=$(echo "$CURRENT" | cut -d. -f1)
    MINOR=$(echo "$CURRENT" | cut -d. -f2)
    PATCH=$(echo "$CURRENT" | cut -d. -f3)
    PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
    VERSION="${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
    echo "Auto-bumping ${CURRENT} → ${VERSION}"
    echo "$VERSION" > VERSION
    git config user.email "github@jedarden.com"
    git config user.name "jedarden"
    git add VERSION
    git commit -m "ci: auto-bump version to ${VERSION}"

# --default-toolchain none, deliberately: NEEDLE's rust-toolchain.toml
# is the single source of truth and pins an exact version. Installing
# `stable` here too makes rustup download TWO toolchains per run, and
# re-resolving the `stable` channel is what broke rust-verify for every
# repo on 2026-08-05 — a mid-job auto-update to 1.97.1 died with
# "Invalid cross-device link (os error 18)" because rustup's temp dir
# and toolchain dir are on different mounts in this image, and
# `cargo check` never ran at all.
#
# With `none`, rustup materialises the pinned toolchain (plus the
# rustfmt/clippy components the file declares) on first cargo use
# inside /workspace. Version is echoed there, once it exists.
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none --profile minimal
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"

curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
  | dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
  | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null
apt-get update && apt-get install -y gh

git clone --depth 1 --branch main \
  "https://github.com/jedarden/NEEDLE.git" \
  /workspace
cd /workspace

# First cargo/rustc call in the repo — rustup installs the toolchain
# pinned by rust-toolchain.toml here, exactly once.
rustc --version

VERSION=$(grep -m1 '^version' Cargo.toml | sed 's/.*= *"\(.*\)".*/\1/')
echo "Building NEEDLE v${VERSION}"
COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

# Run all unit tests and the sanitization latency assertion test.
# Neither `cargo test` invocation below passes --release, so both
# compile and run unoptimized (debug) binaries. Do NOT export
